label: Left Multiplication
subgoals: Let a group act on itself by left multiplication.
The action is faithful because only the identity fixes every element.

label: The Symmetric Group
subgoals: If the group has n elements, the permutations act on n symbols.
The image is therefore a subgroup of the symmetric group on n symbols.

label: What the Theorem Says
subgoals: Cayley's theorem gives an embedding, not a classification.
It shows that permutation groups are universal examples of groups.
